description:
Read the active pixel selection bounds in document pixels (read-only).

Use when: verifying selection exists and its size/position before mask, fill, or recipe steps.
Do NOT use when: creating or modifying a selection — use photoshop_select_rectangle or photoshop_select_subject.

Returns: JSON { ok, summary, details: { has_selection, bounds?, context } }.
Preconditions: active document. Side effects: none.

document_id.description: Optional Photoshop document id from photoshop_get_state / photoshop_list_documents. When set, the tool activates that document before running so a UI tab switch cannot retarget the edit.

name: photoshop_get_selection_bounds
